item.description:
## Highlights
- The CLI now owns the full model lifecycle: automatic loading, downloading, defaults, and streaming. - Prompt prefill pipelines the GDN recurrence across chunks, and the default prefill chunk size is now 4,096 tokens, improving long-prompt throughput. - Prefill selects NAX quantized-matmul tile variants per shape, improving short-prompt prompt-processing throughput with parity on long prompts. - Continuous integration is split into parallel macOS jobs with a shared build cache, shortening feedback loops.
## Compatibility
- Configuration documents remain compatible; the 4,096-token chunk default is materialized for existing configurations without requiring manual edits. - Existing model directories, prompt caches, and user state are preserved.
## Distribution
This release is signed with the Developer ID Application identity, notarized by Apple, and distributed as a stapled DMG through the GitHub release and the signed Sparkle update feed.
